directory.speaker: narrator
text: CENTRAL RING: mess hall and galley dispenser; life support in the south-west corner.
NORTH: Command Deck. WEST: Hydroponics (upper door), Engineering (lower door). EAST: Medical & Research (upper), Crew Quarters (lower). SOUTH: Hangar Bay, stores and the excavation lift.

power.speaker: narrator
text: The reactor and the auxiliary RTG feed one bus. When demand exceeds supply, systems are served strictly in queue order and the rest brown out.
Queue positions can be changed at each system's own console by authorised crew. Current supply: {round(power_supply())} kW. Current demand: {round(power_demand())} kW.

supplies.speaker: narrator
text: Hydroponics delivers ration packs to the galley dispenser. The quartermaster tops the dispenser up from stores when it runs low.
Water in tank: {round(res('water'))} L. Air quality: {round(res('air'))}%. Each crew member uses about 29 L of water a day. Please shower accordingly.

tug.speaker: narrator
tug.text: MCS Calypso's Thread, Combine fleet tug. Departed Day 1. Scheduled return: Day 6, 08:00 ({max(0, round(hours_until(6, 8)))} hours). Supply drone ISD-44: 94 days overdue. No further traffic expected.
